name: agents-comm-bus-hosts
description: Host-specific MCP shim entrypoints for agents-comm-bus

scripts.build: npm run build:claude && npm run build:codex
scripts.build:claude: npx esbuild claude/claude-mcp-shim.js --bundle --platform=node --outfile=../mcp-server/dist/claude-mcp-shim.js --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:codex: npx esbuild codex/codex-mcp-shim.js --bundle --platform=node --outfile=../mcp-server/dist/codex-mcp-shim.js --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
